fr_html: LORD PHILLIMORE propose la division: On voterait d'abord sur l'article 14 du projet Root—Phillimore, sauf rédaction.
en_html: LORD PHILLIMORE proposed that the question under consideration should be divided; a vote should first be taken upon Article 14 of the Root—Phillimore plan, subject to final drafting.
